name: notion中文
examples_zh: 把这份项目周会纪要整理成 Notion 页面，按行动项、负责人和截止日期分区
在 Notion 中为产品需求建立一个看板，包含待评审、开发中、测试中和已发布四列
将这批竞品调研结论整理成 Notion 数据库条目，并添加标签、优先级和链接字段
examples_en: Turn these project meeting notes into a Notion page with sections for action items, owners, and due dates
Create a Notion product requirements board with columns for review, in development, testing, and released
Organize these competitor research findings into Notion database entries with tags, priority, and source links
